caption: A spotlight is swung across a statue on a plinth, and the statue's shadow on the backdrop swings the opposite way.

sa.check: A statue stands on a plinth in front of a backdrop.
A spotlight is swung across it.
The statue's shadow on the backdrop swings the opposite way.
The light moves first and the shadow follows.

pc.expect: The shadow moves only as the light moves.
pc.fail: It swings with the light still; or before the light; or keeps swinging after.

pc.expect: The shadow moves opposite to the light's movement and always falls away from the spotlight.
pc.fail: It moves the same way as the light; or falls toward the spotlight; or stays fixed while the light swings.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the statue's outline, stretching when the light is low and shrinking when overhead.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or one length throughout; or splits.
It turns; or slides; or lifts.

pc.expect: One statue, one spotlight and one shadow.
pc.fail: A second shadow appears; or the statue vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid.

pc.expect: The statue and the backdrop stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The statue changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the backdrop changes.
